annotations.title: Whisper audio transcription: up to 60 minutes of MP3 or WAV, with subtitles

description: Transcribe a podcast, meeting, interview or lecture: up to 60 minutes of MP3 or WAV (25 MB) by URL or uploaded in a POST body, 90+ languages, Whisper large-v3-turbo. Parts are joined, so subtitles=srt or vtt and timestamps=true cover the whole recording; longer audio is refused before anything runs. Use for meeting notes, podcast show notes, video subtitles and interviews; for a short clip in any format, transcribe costs less. Example: url=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/77/Tofino_pronunciation.mp3. Price $0.05/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

language.description: Spoken language code such as en, sv or de (default: detected per part)

subtitles.description: srt or vtt: also return subtitle text for the whole recording

timestamps.description: true: also return timed segments and words

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of an MP3 or WAV file (max 25 MB, 60 minutes); or POST the file itself (raw body, multipart `file` part, or base64 in JSON)
